links.outcome: Change in adenoma detection rate (CUSUM) in non-CADe procedures over time, as a measure of deskilling
links.effect: No deskilling seen. High detectors had accelerated learning curves without CADe; low detectors showed no significant change. Detection rate without CADe was maintained and did not decline.
links.quote: After CADe implementation, the detection rate in procedures performed without CADe was maintained and did not decline over time.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world deployment of a computer-aided detection (CADe) tool for colonoscopy and assesses potential clinician deskilling/learning curve impacts over time, but it does not compare specific deployment practices or organizational safeguards.
